Mobile phone model by Siemens

Find sources: "Siemens SL10" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR (May 2009) (Learn how and when to remove this message)

The Siemens SL10 is a mobile phone with a four-color screen (red, green, blue, and white). It was the second mobile phone with a multicolor screen after the Siemens S10 as well as the first sliding (where the display slides up) mobile phone. [1]
